title: When NORAD Sealed Its Crews Inside Cheyenne Mountain
asof: Figures from US Air Force & Space Force articles · full video on the channel

shots.s: In 2020, crews were sealed inside a mountain.
This is Cheyenne Mountain, NORAD's nuclear-proof bunker in Colorado.
Normally, nobody sleeps here. Crews go home after their shift.
But when COVID hit, NORAD and Northern Command moved critical crews inside.
They isolated first and got tested.
Then they worked inside for weeks.
About a hundred and thirty people stood twelve-hour watches.
Under about eighteen hundred feet of granite.
Could you work a whole shift without seeing the sun?
